## Appearance

Gilbert is a tall, broad-shouldered fellow with curly brown hair, hazel eyes, and a frank, handsome face. Often recognized by a teasing smile, his expression features clear and straightforward eyes. Following a period away, he returned home noticeably pale and thin.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P28](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0028), [v1 CHAPTER XXVIII. ## Personality

Gilbert Blythe is a clever and good-natured young man who approaches life with a strong sense of humor, constant good spirits, and a thoughtful, kind demeanor. Driven by a determination to get the best out of life and contribute his best in return, he actively pursues academic excellence, aiming to win a scholarship, achieve High Honors, and earn the Cooper Prize. Professionally, he aspires to become a doctor to do honest work and combat disease, pain, and ignorance. His personal ambitions are deeply shaped by his devotion to [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), striving to measure up to her ideal with the ultimate goal of marrying her and building a home together.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P36](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0036), [v1 CHAPTER XXXV. ## History

Gilbert Blythe returned to [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) after spending three years in Alberta with his father and visiting cousins in [New Brunswick](../codex/places.md#new-brunswick). Upon returning to school, he pulled [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) Shirley's hair and called her "Carrots," prompting her to smash a slate over his head and refuse his attempts to apologize. Over the next few years, Gilbert maintained a intense academic rivalry with [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) while attempting to rescue her when her boat sank, though she initially refused his offer of friendship. After they both earned high marks on the Queen's [Entrance](../codex/places.md#entrance) examination and attended Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#queen-s-academy) together, Gilbert won the medal while [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) earned the Avery scholarship. Upon learning that [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) planned to give up college to care for [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) following Matthew's death, Gilbert generously gave up his post as the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) schoolteacher so [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) could take the job, which finally led to their reconciliation and close friendship. Together, they founded the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) Young People's [Improvement Society](../codex/factions.md#improvement-society) and frequently discussed their teaching experiences, literary ambitions, and community projects. Following two years of teaching, Gilbert resigned to attend [Redmond College](../codex/places.md#redmond-college) alongside [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), where he led the Freshmen to victory in the Arts Rush and took High Honors in Classics along with winning the Cooper Prize. During their second year at [Redmond](../codex/places.md#redmond-college), Gilbert met [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) in an orchard and proposed to her, but she rejected his offer of romance and insisted they remain only friends. Crushed by the rejection, Gilbert distanced himself, leaving [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) feeling a lonely ache over his absence while rumors circulated that he was courting [Christine Stuart](../character/christine-stuart.md). Years later, after graduating from [Redmond](../codex/places.md#redmond-college), Gilbert fell critically ill with typhoid fever, an event that caused [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to realize her true love for him. After his fever broke, Gilbert asked [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to walk with him to Hester Gray's garden, where he proposed a second time, and she happily accepted.

## Quotes

> “All right!” Gilbert sprang into his skiff with an angry color in his cheeks. “I’ll never ask you to be friends again, Anne Shirley. And I don’t care either!”
>
> — Gilbert Blythe — [v1 CHAPTER XXVIII. An Unfortunate Lily Maid P34](../source/v01-c28.md#nw-v01-c28-p0034)

> "You’re just tired, Anne. Come, forget it all and take a walk with me—a ramble back through the woods beyond the marsh. There should be something there I want to show you."
>
> — Gilbert Blythe — [v3 ch.Autumn P15](../source/v03-c02.md#nw-v03-c02-p0015)

> "No. I only know it should be, from something I saw there in spring. Come on. We’ll pretend we are two children again and we’ll go the way of the wind."
>
> — Gilbert Blythe — [v3 ch.Autumn P17](../source/v03-c02.md#nw-v03-c02-p0017)

> "Here’s a fallen tree with a cushion of moss. Sit down, Anne—it will serve for a woodland throne. I’ll climb for some apples. They all grow high—the tree had to reach up to the sunlight."
>
> — Gilbert Blythe — [v3 ch.Autumn P34](../source/v03-c02.md#nw-v03-c02-p0034)

> "No, I shall not be in Avonlea at all this summer, Anne. I’ve been offered a job in the Daily News office and I’m going to take it."
>
> — Gilbert Blythe — [v3 ch.Speaks P23](../source/v03-c20.md#nw-v03-c20-p0023)

## Relationships

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--gilbert-blythe.md)

Gilbert and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) began their relationship in childhood as intense academic rivals, starting after Gilbert teased her by pulling her hair and calling her "Carrots." Although [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) held a long grudge, Gilbert once rescued her from a leaking boat on the pond, and they eventually reconciled to become close study partners, fellow teachers, and supportive friends. Their bond expanded as they shared quiet, romantic walks and discussed their future ambitions together.

### [Shirley](../character/shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/gilbert-blythe--shirley.md)

Gilbert and [Shirley](../character/shirley.md) started as fierce academic rivals competing for the top marks in school, a competition that culminated in Gilbert winning the academic medal while [Shirley](../character/shirley.md) earned a scholarship. Over time, their intense rivalry softened into a warm, comfortable friendship. They frequently took walks and shared intimate moments, including a quiet walk home from a wedding that marked a subtle romantic awakening in their relationship.
